svg.text: Scenario presets — the preset editor, the load dialog, the split ▶, the toolbar states (design §5)
Scope: the Parameters section, the load dialog's side pane, ▶ and the mode glyph. Everything drawn grey-dashed is context — unchanged.
Preview only — a world built with a variant can't be saved (some entities may be missing).
Add / rename / remove act on EVERY preset (one undo step).
The combo picks what the TABLE shows and edits —
Move up / down · Reset all to default
the description — scrolls in its own box
(was above the Run setup expander, which it pushed
out of sight in a short window)
Open = load for editing with the preset
▾ arms a preset; never the mode

Night attack, paused at its start
Save is off: this world was built with variant 3 —
entities whose Presence roll failed are not in it.
